versions.changelog: Reworked demand generation to use real 2011 Census worker counts as spatial weights across Mumbai's 24 lettered BMC administrative wards, aggregated up from 97 real Census fine-ward codes via a crosswalk table (the only non-government source used in this project's ward-level work), replacing the old subdistrict-level average. Fixed the same lat/lon coordinate-order bug found in Kolkata's boundary source. All 97 fine-ward codes and all 24 admin wards matched with zero unmatched codes.
